## Core

|---|---|
| [`bi-dashboard-design`](skills/bi-dashboard-design/SKILL.md) | Shared design system for business dashboards in Power BI, Tableau and Looker — page layout grid, level-of-detail tiers (executive, manager, analyst), KPI card anatomy, chart selection, color, number formatting, filters, drill paths and accessibility. |

## Platform builders

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`looker-dashboard-builder`](skills/looker-dashboard-builder/SKILL.md) | Builds Looker semantic models and dashboards from a dashboard spec — LookML views, explores and models, measures with period-over-period and snapshot logic, drill fields, access filters, and LookML dashboards (.dashboard.lookml) on the newspaper layout. |
| [`powerbi-dashboard-builder`](skills/powerbi-dashboard-builder/SKILL.md) | Builds Power BI semantic models and reports from a dashboard spec — star schema in TMDL (PBIP project format), DAX measures with time intelligence and semi-additive patterns, report pages in PBIR, themes, drill-through, field parameters and row-level security. |
| [`tableau-dashboard-builder`](skills/tableau-dashboard-builder/SKILL.md) | Builds Tableau dashboards and published data sources from a dashboard spec — relationship-based data models, calculated fields and LOD expressions, .tds/.twb XML, dashboard layout containers, actions, parameters, and Tableau Next semantic models. |
